observation: The gfx1201 HIP streaming route segfaults when the gfx1201 build selects physical device ordinal 1 with mixed GPU architectures visible, but succeeds with graph capture enabled when the R9700 is isolated as logical device 0.
evidence: repeated GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 runs did not eliminate the crash
matched offline and streaming runs with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 and --device 0 exited successfully; streaming logs include graph warmup completion
amdahl_ceiling: Correctness blocker; performance ceiling is not yet meaningful.
suspected_mechanism: ROCm 7.2.1 or the ggml HIP backend mishandles device ordinals/state when a single-architecture gfx1201 binary sees a mixed-architecture device registry.
cheapest_falsifier: Repeat the same graph-enabled command with all devices visible at ordinal 1 and with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 at ordinal 0.
implementation_cost: P0 configuration workaround; P2 root-cause fix
